text: haha yeah.. as i was typing that message out i realized how insane it is when its all just an algorithm, so do anything more sane than that
resolution: Built a host-authoritative Path Array for selected model parts or complete outliner groups. It generates constant-radius arc/eased-grade bays or explicit XYZ boundary-point runs, preserves independent part ranges and face paint, groups/focuses the results, and journals the complete operation as one exact undo rather than requiring cumulative edge-ring nudges.
